title.narrative: Professional Development of Teachers in Pakistan

description.narrative: Die Bildungssituation in Pakistan ist sehr schlecht. Das liegt vor allem an der mangelnden Ausbildung der Lehrkräfte. Das von der katholischen Kirche gegründete Institut widmet sich daher der Qualifizierung der angehenden und bestehenden Lehrkräfte, insbesondere auch bezüglich der Vermittlung gesellschaftsrelevanter Inhalte, die die Schüler*innen besser auf die Probleme und Zukunft des Landes vorbereiten. The educational situation in Pakistan is very poor. This is mainly due to the lack of training for teachers. The institute, founded by the Catholic Church, is therefore dedicated to training prospective and existing teachers, particularly in teaching socially relevant content that better prepares students for the problems and future of the country. In view of the advance of religious fundamentalism, values such as tolerance, mutual respect and solidarity with minorities are important to teach. The project will train at least 3,000 teachers from church, public and community schools.
